who: Gertrude Fairweather is a harassed mother of four boys living just west of Varrock, her merchant husband away and her house full of cats. She takes in sick and abandoned animals, raised Bob from a kitten left on her doorstep, and has a soft heart for cats and none at all for stray dogs or the sewers.
